metadata.assessment_type: Strong subjective structural-prior scenario; not an empirically validated district parameter calibration.

units.p: Probability of exit from the state during one month, combining all exit pathways.
units.gamma: New entries per month divided by the under-five population; a fraction.
units.omega: Total standard deviation of monthly entries divided by the under-five population; a fraction, not a variance or additional dispersion component.

metadata.parameterization: For every parameter, mean = a/(a+b), concentration = a+b, variance = mean*(1-mean)/(concentration+1).

elicitation.p_centres: 0.22–0.36: qualitative access tiers; lower values reflect assumed recovery barriers and higher values reflect potential access in service centres. The absolute scale is an elicitation choice, not a measured duration.
elicitation.gamma_centres: 0.010–0.024 per month: qualitative food-access and vulnerability tiers. No annual rate was substituted for a monthly rate, and no prevalence-to-incidence conversion was used.
elicitation.omega_centres: 0.004–0.013: qualitative tiers for genuine recurring process variation. No survey uncertainty, field-team access or missingness informed these centres.
elicitation.interpretation: Concentrations are deliberately strong at the user's request. They describe uncertainty about parameter values, not sample sizes from verified district evidence; limited evidence widens the priors without adding process variation to omega.
elicitation.dependence: Only the requested marginal Beta priors are supplied. Prior independence is a modelling assumption, not established by the contextual evidence. No equilibrium prevalence, implied prevalence ranking or likelihood outcome was used to select or screen the priors.

evidence_limits: Structural documents support qualitative contrasts but do not identify absolute incidence, total-exit probabilities or monthly arrival standard deviations. The narrow numerical distributions are analyst assumptions and should not be described as evidence-proven district estimates.

Comparable district-level CMAM coverage, treatment durations, facility densities, skilled attendance and chronic under-five mortality were not verified across all 74 districts. Urban/rural service contrasts are proxies; the presence of a town or a programme is not evidence of high CMAM coverage or reliable supplies.

A chronic district-specific IPC Acute Food Insecurity baseline was not verified from a complete 2017–2021 series. No district phase was invented or assigned from a peak crisis, and no phase label was used in the numerical calibration.

The evidence does not establish an acute-and-fatal versus chronic-and-persistent phenotype for each district. Poor access can prolong illness or increase mortality; no district received a mortality-driven upward p adjustment without independent duration and fatality evidence.

Mixed-livelihood districts are represented qualitatively, without verified population-weighted livelihood shares. Banadir represents the supplied aggregate, and Gaalkacyo is treated as the supplied whole district; later boundary or conflict changes were not imported.

Displacement-related gamma adjustments are made where persistent hosting is documented, especially Banadir, Baydhaba, Bossaso, Doolow and Kismaayo. An undocumented district is not assumed to have no displacement; no stock estimate was inferred from a flow-monitoring checkpoint.

OCHA's regional evidence informs cautious district access assumptions, not claims that every rural district was continuously inaccessible. A single access snapshot and two climate bulletins do not constitute a complete five-year district history.

Arrival-count distributions and under-five population sizes were not supplied. These marginal priors do not establish a count-distribution floor for omega or validate the Gaussian likelihood; seasonal dependence is represented only through the time-invariant parameters requested.
metadata.outcome_separation: No prohibited outcome was used in the calibration or district reasoning. Search engines incidentally returned outcome-bearing snippets and mixed-document passages; these were discarded. Restricted nutrition survey reports were not opened, and no extracted outcome values, phases, narratives or derived quantities were retained as evidence.
